extension.summary: Watch NZ On Screen's public video catalogue
extension.description: Browse television, film, series, music videos, collections, interviews and profiles from NZ On Screen. Includes search, nested pages, artwork, metadata and Widevine DASH playback.
extension.disclaimer: Unofficial community add-on. Content, availability, regional restrictions and rights are controlled by NZ On Screen. Rentals and account-only content are not bypassed.
